<h1>Welcome! I'm Sofia. </h1>

I'm an early-career environmental data scientist passionate about data communication, visualization, and statistical analysis. I recently completed a Master of Environmental Data Science at the Bren School of Environmental Science & Management, and am currently searching for roles in NYC! 
<br>

Click around my wesbite to learn more about me and all of my fun little projects :)

::: panel-tabset
